records.context: Rows describe signed camera-linear estimates at the recorded broadened common PSF, not concentrations or original-resolution dye amounts. Negative values remain signed. Sum is the sum of cell pixel values without pixel-area scaling or additional background subtraction; standard deviation uses ddof zero. Centroids are geometric rather than intensity weighted. Coordinates use zero-based full-reference pixel indices and exclusive upper bounding-box indices; micrometre coordinates multiply those indices by recorded Y/X spacing and do not claim an absolute microscope stage position.
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_calibrated_cells#2
records.source: Rows describe signed camera-linear estimates at the recorded broadened common PSF, not concentrations or original-resolution dye amounts. Negative values remain signed. Sum is the sum of cell pixel values without pixel-area scaling or additional background subtraction; standard deviation uses ddof zero. Centroids are geometric rather than intensity weighted. Coordinates use zero-based full-reference pixel indices and exclusive upper bounding-box indices; micrometre coordinates multiply those indices by recorded Y/X spacing and do not claim an absolute microscope stage position.
records.translation: Raderna beskriver signerade kameralinjära skattningar vid den registrerade, breddade gemensamma PSF, inte koncentrationer eller färgämnesmängder vid ursprunglig upplösning. Negativa värden behåller sitt tecken. Summan är summan av cellernas pixelvärden utan skalning med pixelarea eller ytterligare bakgrundssubtraktion; standardavvikelsen använder ddof noll. Tyngdpunkterna är geometriska och inte intensitetsviktade. Koordinaterna använder nollbaserade pixelindex i hela referensbilden och exkluderande övre index för begränsningsrutan; mikrometerkoordinater multiplicerar dessa index med det registrerade Y/X-avståndet och anger inte en absolut position för mikroskopets objektbord.

records.context: This route writes only cells.csv and provenance.json in a new directory. Cell labels are preserved from 1 to 65535; zero is background and larger labels are refused under the current calibrated producer contract. POSIX descriptor-relative path safeguards and an atomic exclusive-directory rename must be available; unsupported platforms or filesystems refuse. It performs no extracted image region export, texture or relative statistics, reprocessing, normalization, raw-database append or uint16 conversion. Boundary-excluded cells remain excluded and are recorded in provenance.
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_calibrated_cells#3
records.source: This route writes only cells.csv and provenance.json in a new directory. Cell labels are preserved from 1 to 65535; zero is background and larger labels are refused under the current calibrated producer contract. POSIX descriptor-relative path safeguards and an atomic exclusive-directory rename must be available; unsupported platforms or filesystems refuse. It performs no crop export, texture or relative statistics, reprocessing, normalization, raw-database append or uint16 conversion. Boundary-excluded cells remain excluded and are recorded in provenance.
records.translation: Denna väg skriver endast cells.csv och provenance.json i en ny katalog. Celletiketterna bevaras från 1 till 65535; noll är bakgrund och större etiketter avvisas enligt det aktuella kontraktet för den kalibrerade producenten. POSIX-skydd för sökvägar relativt filbeskrivare och ett atomärt namnbyte till en exklusivt ny katalog måste vara tillgängliga; plattformar eller filsystem som inte stöds avvisas. Ingen export av bildutsnitt, texturstatistik eller relativ statistik, ombearbetning, normalisering, tillägg till rådatabasen eller uint16-konvertering utförs. Celler som uteslutits vid gränsen förblir uteslutna och registreras i proveniensen.
